data.name: Floating Paradise
data.detailed_description:
Search Every Angle of Paradise

Floating Paradise takes the classic seek-and-find formula into full 3D. Instead of scanning a flat illustration, you have complete control over an isometric floating island diorama. Rotate the camera, zoom into tight corners, and inspect every nook and cranny to locate all the hidden objects tucked away across the landscape.

There are no timers, no score penalties, and no rush. Take your time, soak in the scenery, and enjoy a tactile scavenger hunt designed to help you unwind.

Key Features

  • Full 360-degree orbital camera controls to inspect the island from any perspective

  • Handcrafted 3D dioramas packed with detailed hidden objects and micro-scenes

  • A complete, fully playable island experience included entirely for free

  • A calming, atmospheric soundtrack tailored for stress-free puzzle solving

  • Accessible gameplay with simple mouse controls and no fail states

Free Base Game & Future DLC

The base game includes the first complete floating island map at zero cost. If you enjoy the experience and want to continue hunting for secrets, additional themed islands with fresh environments, unique items, and new music tracks will be available as DLC.

data.short_description: Rotate, zoom, and inspect a vibrant 3D floating island to uncover cleverly hidden items. Floating Paradise is a cozy, free-to-play isometric hidden object game featuring smooth orbital controls and a relaxing lo-fi soundtrack.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Microsoft Windows 10 (latest SP) 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5 @ 3.0 GHz or higher (or AMD equivalent)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce 750/Radeon R9 270X or higher
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Microsoft Windows 10 (latest SP) 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Quad Core i7 @ 4.5 GHz or higher (or AMD equivalent)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce 1070 GTX / Radeon RX Vega 56 or higher
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
